chord.description: Hosted no-key MCP: DEX swap quotes and unsigned txs on 7 EVM chains (Base, Monad, BNB Chain, Avalanche, Arbitrum, Robinhood Chain, Arc), token boards, candles, wallet PnL, smart money, holders and LP pools. About 60 requests a minute without a key; only chord_ask needs a Chord API key. Non-custodial.
